description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for a Settings page allowing users to customize theme mode, toggle notifications, view account info, and sign out. It interacts with repositories and controllers for preferences and authentication.

classes.name: SettingsPage
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays user settings such as theme mode, notifications, and account info, with options for signing out.

classes.name: _SettingsPageState
classes.description: State class for SettingsPage, managing user preferences, loading state, and user interactions.

classes.name: _CardSection
classes.description: A reusable widget for displaying grouped settings sections with a title and child content.

classes.name: _ThemeTile
classes.description: A widget representing a radio list tile for selecting theme modes (system, light, dark).

classes.name: _BrandNote
classes.description: A widget showing an informational note with branding and customization guidance.

methods.name: _loadPrefs
methods.description: Fetches theme mode and notifications preferences from repository and updates state.

methods.name: _onThemeChanged
methods.description: Handles theme mode change, persists preference, and updates theme controller.

methods.name: _signOut
methods.description: Performs user sign out via authentication repository.
